items.description: Replacement pipe section, sealing and insulation
items.rationale: Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) cover the failed indoor supply-pipe section and its like-for-like repair materials. The €100 gross estimate reflects one short pipe section, sealing and standard rock-wool insulation, with labour priced separately.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers necessary labour at customary rates. The invoice gives one flat-rate unit rather than an hour count, so the gross estimate uses the €76 prior for the single billed unit.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows one travel charge per contractor per invoice regardless of the number of visits. This is the only travel charge on the building-services invoice, estimated at €81 gross.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover necessary drying and one equipment deployment charge per drying operation. The single flat rate is estimated at €439 gross using the comparable bathroom-wall loss.

items.description: Close and repaint the wall opening
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(a) cover making good the necessary access opening and repainting the disturbed patch, not the rest of the room. The comparable bathroom-wall repair supports €453 gross for the combined line.
